function.name: calculate_electric_current
function.description: Calculate the electric current through a conductor given voltage and resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

voltage.description: The voltage across the conductor in Volts. This is a float type value.

resistance.description: The resistance of the conductor in Ohms. This is a float type value.

conductance.description: The conductance of the conductor in Siemens. Optional if resistance is provided. Default: 0.3 This is a float type value.

message.content:
電力（電）並不是由某一個人「發現」的，而是經過多位科學家逐步揭示其本質與規律。以下是幾位關鍵人物：

| 時期 | 科學家 | 主要貢獻 |
|------|--------|----------|
| 古希臘 | 泰勒斯（Thales） | 觀察到靜電現象（摩擦產生的帶電） |
| 1600 年代 | 威廉·吉爾伯特（William Gilbert） | 在《De Magnete》一書中首次將磁性與靜電分開，提出「電」這一術語 |
| 1700 年代 | 本傑明·富蘭克林（Benjamin Franklin） | 進行閃電實驗，提出正負電荷概念，發明閃電針 |
| 1800 年代 | 阿萊桑德羅·伏打（Alessandro Volta） | 發明伏打電池，證明電流可以由化學反應產生 |
| 1800 年代 | 亞歷山大·貝爾（Alexander von Humboldt） | 研究地球電場與雷電 |
| 19 世紀 | 赫爾曼·冯·亥姆霍兹（Heinrich Hertz） | 驗證電磁波存在，奠定電磁理論基礎 |

簡而言之，電力的「發現」是一個累積的歷史過程，從古代對靜電的觀察，到近代對電流、電壓、電阻等概念的建立，形成了今天我們所熟知的電學體系。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "誰發現了電力？" meaning "Who discovered electricity?" They want an answer. We can provide a concise answer: Electricity was known since antiquity, but its systematic study began with scientists like William Gilbert, Benjamin Franklin, Alessandro Volta, etc. The discovery of electricity as a phenomenon is not attributed to a single person; early observations by Thales, then William Gilbert's work on magnetism and electricity, Benjamin Franklin's experiments, etc. So answer accordingly. No function call needed.
